title: Normalize Mathematical Plugin Crate To Consistency Contract
description: Normalize mathematical/plugin/rs/lib.rs to the Consistency Contract (Wave 2/3 sweep): rename MathPlayApp -> MathematicalPlayApp (C1), fix region markers and canonical ordering including "// #region 🔖Tests" -> "//#region 🧪Tests" (C2/C3), adopt semio_framework_plugin::app_labels!/LocaleLabels/localized_label_map/AppLabelsOverlayExt for Terminology (C5), verify resource_kind declarations, single-app crate stays flat (C4 n/a). Scope strictly limited to mathematical/plugin/rs/** and any colocated fixtures under mathematical/**.
summary: Normalized mathematical/plugin/rs/lib.rs to the Consistency Contract. C1: renamed app struct MathPlayApp -> MathematicalPlayApp everywhere (definition, impl, semio_plugin! manifest entry, both test call sites); app id string "mathematical-play" left unchanged. C2/C3: fixed the buggy "// #region 🔖Tests" / "// #endregion 🔖Tests" markers to "//#region 🧪Tests" / "//#endregion 🧪Tests"; reordered regions into canonical order (Constants -> Document -> Operation -> GraphAlgorithms -> Geometry -> Terminology -> CommandLabels -> Render -> MathematicalPlayApp(impl) -> Manifest -> Tests) by moving Terminology+CommandLabels up from after the app impl to before Render. C5: replaced the hand-rolled MathLabels struct + MATH_LABELS_NATIVE_EN/DE consts + math_labels() resolver with semio_framework_plugin::app_labels!{ struct MathematicalLabels { ... } } + resolve_labels::<MathematicalLabels>(); replaced math_action_labels()'s manual (id,en,de)->HashMap loop with localized_label_map(); replaced the manual AppLabelsOverlay{ .. } struct-literal construction in DocumentApp::app_labels with the AppLabelsOverlayExt fluent builder (.window_kind_label x2, .mode_label, .action_labels, .example_labels). C4: single-app crate, stays flat, no mod wrapper (n/a). Step 2 PanelKit: n/a - crate has no tree_item/PanelTreeBuilder/build_document_tree/build_inspector_tree/build_catalogue_tree usage at all; it renders NodeGraphScene/Canvas2dScene component scenes only, so nothing to lift. Step 4 resource_kind: verified n/a - app has no OS-level file import/export surface (in-memory graph+point-cloud playground only), correctly has zero .resource_kind(...) calls; nothing to add. Step 8 Testkit: n/a - crate had no local meta()/new_app()/new_app_with_registry()/MemoryBackbone::pair scaffolding and no undo-redo/convergence/idempotency test bodies to begin with; the two render_* tests are app-specific UI-shape assertions, left untouched per instructions. Verified: rustfmt --check --config-path rustfmt.toml is clean after auto-format; manual brace/paren balance check passed; exhaustive grep cross-reference confirms zero residual references to MathPlayApp/MathLabels/math_labels/math_action_labels/MATH_LABELS_* anywhere under mathematical/**; confirmed via framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs source read (not guessed) that app_labels!/LocaleLabels/resolve_labels/is_de_locale/localized_label_map/AppLabelsOverlayExt signatures match usage exactly, and that AppLabelsOverlay derives Default. Skipped: full `cargo check -p mathematical-plugin` - blocked >150s on "Blocking waiting for file lock on build directory" due to concurrent workspace-wide cargo contention from other sessions; left running in background, did not force through. Nothing to flag for Wave 4's audit - this crate maps cleanly onto every SDK primitive it needed (PanelKit/Testkit simply don't apply here; Terminology mapped 1:1).
